capture.geometry: Actual public-only versus Lab-preferred then sequential public-supplement helper calls. Same WS inputs, no pertrip refinements. Supplemental public event explicitly marked; all response receipts causal.

note: Actual public-only vs preferred Lab + sequential public supplement using the transport helper, exact receipt events, same AVL and trajectories. Per-trip refinement intentionally omitted; geometry availability gate, not full native cold-start performance. Confidence dimming does not remove markers or exempt motion audits.

public.geometryCaveat: Actual captured geometry receipts; provisional seeds and pertrip refinement. Harness loader concurrency differs from native scheduler.
public.legacyMetricCaveat: Legacy top-level slew/hold counters retain the historical discontinuity filter for comparison only. Use completeDisplayAudit for every actual frame, correction, both acceleration signs and visibility.

completeDisplayAudit.note: Every submitted replay state counted, including server-sanctioned resets. Displacement-derived speed around a reset describes visible teleport, not physical tram speed. Crossings are descriptive, not proof that a source-designated served/express/terminal stop should have held.
completeDisplayAudit.rawGpsTargetNote: Receipt-time separation from the latest GPS target while no route axis is available, not timestamp-matched position accuracy. Includes stale input and fade stages.
completeDisplayAudit.worldVectorNote: Finite differences of actual longitude/latitude positions, including raw GPS retargets, lateral alignment and route curvature. Route vertices can exceed correction-only acceleration/jerk bounds; no geometry-change exemption.

public.caveat: Sampled captured inputs, known geometry-pack trips only. No rider ground truth; source timestamps and delivery timing preserved. CPU is Node on host, not Hermes/native rendering.
